storage_sensitivity.historical_issue: A previous assertion that same-seed CSR and dense multistart fits must agree failed on this reference. That equality is not a property of the method and is not asserted here.
storage_sensitivity.consequence: Report the actual CSR storage path and resulting fit. Neither matching nor differing local optima alone establishes algorithmic superiority.

qualification: Dense-reference equality remains a separately performed test. CSR checks establish the same operations on the declared inputs; they do not claim bit-identical random trajectories or global optimality.
